name: WEBSTAR
about: WEBSTAR is a web design studio that sells websites in clear, fixed tiers. Each reel shows a screen recording of one website it built, scrolling on a phone.
audience: Small business owners who want a site like the one on screen and want to know what they are getting.
rules: Short, energetic sentences. Plain words, a bit of personality, no corporate language.
cta: Pick a tier — link in bio
spokenCta: Pick a tier. Link in bio.
commentPrompt: Comment WEBSITE and we'll send you the link.
introScene: A bright, friendly home office or café table in natural daylight, plants and a notebook nearby, warm and casual.
